issues.detail: The parcel is densely planted with palms, large crowns, and shadows, while the diagram shows a sparse desert distribution and no authored hole trees. The planting is especially crowded around the Hole 1 and Hole 2 fairway corridors.
issues.consequence: The overview makes the mapped desert landscape look like a densely landscaped course and visually crowds the tee-to-landing and fairway-to-green corridors.
